TrialScout is a computational tool that uses an LLM to match clinical trial registrations (ClinicalTrials.gov) to result publications (PubMed). It directly addresses academic literature discovery and verification (INC-01), incorporates LLM for matching (INC-02), implements citation/linkage verification between registrations and publications (INC-03), and provides quantitative empirical evaluation with sensitivity 92.5%, specificity 81.2% on 9,600 trials (INC-04). Highly relevant to all three RQs: architecture/provenance (RQ1), trust/integrity mechanisms (RQ2), empirical evaluation (RQ3).
